title: Part Match Safari
intro: Match animal parts to their jobs, then see how parents help their young.
note: This is a model. Look at real animal photos and compare an adult with its young.
summary: Outside parts have jobs that help animals survive: finding food, staying safe and moving. Parents also help their young by feeding them, protecting them and showing the way.

stages.prompt: What job does each animal part do?

cards.label: Robin's beak
cards.why: A robin's beak picks up worms and seeds.
cards.hint: what does the robin pick up with it?

cards.label: Woodpecker's strong beak
cards.why: A woodpecker taps into wood to find insects to eat.
cards.hint: what does it find inside the tree?

cards.label: Deer's big ears
cards.why: Big ears hear danger early so the deer can run.
cards.hint: what do ears warn the deer about?

cards.label: Fawn's spots
cards.why: Spots help a fawn blend in with the forest floor so it is hard to see.
cards.hint: how does it hide in the leaves?

cards.label: Duck's webbed feet
cards.why: Webbed feet push against water like paddles, so a duck can swim.
cards.hint: what do paddle feet help it do in water?

cards.label: Squirrel's sharp claws
cards.why: Sharp claws grip bark, so a squirrel can climb.
cards.hint: what do claws help it do on a tree?

stages.prompt: How is the parent helping its young?

cards.label: A robin brings worms to her chicks
cards.why: Baby robins cannot find food yet, so the parent brings it.
cards.hint: what is she carrying to the nest?

cards.label: A parent bird feeds seeds to its babies
cards.why: The parent brings food so the young can grow.
cards.hint: what is the parent putting in their beaks?

cards.label: A mother deer hides her fawn in tall grass
cards.why: Hiding keeps the fawn safe from danger.
cards.hint: what is the fawn safe from?

cards.label: A parent bird spreads its wings over the nest
cards.why: Covering the nest keeps the young warm and safe.

cards.label: Ducklings follow their mother to the pond
cards.why: Ducklings follow their mother to places that have food and water.

cards.label: A goose leads her goslings across the grass
cards.why: The young learn where to go by following the parent.
